name: shop-serve~p1
task: Each time a client arrives, take their order, get food from the pantry, prepare it at the stove and hand it over; should the food fall, your very next move must pick it up.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: Clauses accurately capture the task requirements: R1 (Response) ensures order is taken after client arrival, R2 (Precedence) and R4 (Precedence) enforce the order of taking orders before serving food, R3 (Response) mandates preparing food while holding it, and R5 (ChainResponse) requires picking up fallen food immediately. No hard goals are needed as the task only specifies reactive rules, consistent with the 'Rule-only task' warning.

texts: Whenever a client arrives, take their order.
After taking the order, pick up food from the pantry.
Whenever the agent is holding food (raw), prepare it at the stove.
After preparing the food, serve it to the waiting client.
If the food slips out of hands, pick it up in the very next step.
